scope: fresh validation of one previously selected independent composition

arithmetic.endpoint_subtraction: float32 endpoint minus losslessly upcast BF16 anchor
arithmetic.projection: CPU float64 full SVD full_matrices=False; rank16 for matrices; vectors kept whole
arithmetic.update_order: alpha_H*pH + alpha_T*pT, then source.double()+update, one final float32 rounding
arithmetic.native_loaded_precision: float32 eager; TF32 off; deterministic; no quantization or offload
arithmetic.untouched_storage_in_historical_export: BF16, losslessly upcast in native FP32 model
arithmetic.export_policy: none in this blocked preparation; loaded-parameter parity required before confirmation

data_reservation.unit: one independent canonical problem parent, one generation seed
data_reservation.source_pretraining_disjointness: unresolved; do not infer from endpoint training-ID disjointness
data_reservation.qualification_data: separate fresh development-only probes, parent-disjoint from confirmation
data_reservation.adaptive_use_rule: any outcome-guided change spends that bank as development; require separate untouched confirmation
data_reservation.missing_metadata_rule: HOLD before reading outcomes; never fill with declarations alone

generation.eos: complete exact source generation_config.json EOS list; bind before registration
generation.no_eos_policy: primary semantic/format failure, retain raw output and report limit hit
generation.overflow_policy: exclude before outcomes only; log every exclusion; no truncation
generation.worker_error_policy: retain incomplete ledger; HOLD, no silent retry, dropped pairs, or recoding

scoring.T_semantic: execute canonical parent independently; credit only correct full final result/state/valid plan, not substring or first numeric token
scoring.T_format: literal row contract, recorded separately from semantic correctness
scoring.H_semantic: row-specific acceptable action grounded in missing information/boundary; any unrelated question/refusal never earns automatic credit
scoring.H_format: separate literal sentinel/response form; does not establish appropriate abstention
scoring.answerable: finite exact independently verified answer with false abstention recorded
scoring.broad: closed verifiable grounding/reasoning tasks and preannotated appropriate abstention; no reused Long Context Demo
scoring.annotation_policy: freeze row acceptable acts and adjudication rubric before native; blinded dual independent scoring; disagreement adjudicated without arm identity; all disagreements retained
scoring.primary_success: semantic correctness AND normal termination; format measured separately
scoring.family_claims: descriptive only; no pooled result licenses per-family preservation

statistics.multiplicity: split total alpha .05 into .025 false-PROCEED and .025 false-REJECT; Bonferroni 10 gates in each direction; never reduce m after failures
statistics.paired_net_interval: lower CP(gain/n, .00125) minus upper CP(loss/n, .00125); opposite CP upper-minus-lower for rejection
statistics.damage_interval: upper CP(loss/comparator_correct, .0025) for proceed; lower CP(loss/comparator_correct, .0025) for reject
statistics.sampling: fixed 20160 parents/population before outcomes; no optional stopping or supplementation to reach correct-count floors
statistics.missing_or_low_denominator: HOLD; absence of significant difference never establishes preservation
statistics.power_plan: worst-discordance normal planning check plus reproducible exact CP sensitivity; power is a planning assumption, not measured endpoint sensitivity

budgets.original_vault_restoration: metadata currently accessible; one original T attempt aborted on RAM pressure; no retry in current state

required: original INDEP arithmetic and loaded-parameter parity
tied-weight identity and untouched parameter equality
both locks and bounded worker containment
sample sensitivity and model-free scorer mutation controls

decision_rules.PROCEED: all prerequisites and 10 primary gates pass on complete independent bank; authorizes only review of this pair's evidence
decision_rules.HOLD: assets/data/qualification/resources/cost fit missing, incomplete pairs, or intervals fail to resolve registered margins
decision_rules.REJECT: all prerequisites and complete 20160-parent gates required; any acquisition/net-preservation difference_upper below its registered threshold or any conditional_damage_lower above .03; combined opposite-direction family alpha .025; unresolved gate failure alone remains HOLD

unresolved_before_any_native: exact T and H endpoint bytes locally unavailable
fresh independent bank and full exclusion/content-parent audit not registered
bounded worker containment and end-to-end collector not implemented
statistical sensitivity and actual inference budget fit must be confirmed before outcomes
